question: did the aims global network ceo visit the ttp centre at ens yaounde
answer: Yes — Mr. Thierry Zomahoun, President and CEO of the AIMS Global Network, visited the TTP Centre at ENS Yaoundé on 27 October 2016.
evidence: Mr. Thierry Zomahoun, President and CEO of the AIMS Global Network, visited the TTP Centre at ENS Yaoundé.
